categories.name: Central Storage
categories.description: information on the storage that the sample(s) will be added to.

categories.name: Sample Information
categories.description: Information such as the data asset location or path to the sample being added to the store

categories.name: Run params
categories.description: ingest parameters, such as what celltypist model to run, and storage addition configuration

parameters.name: Storage Location
parameters.description: Icechunk repo (data asset, local path or s3://bucket/prefix) or .zarr folder the samples are added to. If it does not exist, it is created at an s3:// prefix you can write to, or inside /results or /scratch.
parameters.help_text: A store you will keep adding to belongs on S3. /data is read-only; a store in /results can be saved as a data asset but is then read-only too, and /scratch is cleared when the run ends.

parameters.name: Origin of s3(optional)
parameters.description: If the storage is a read-only data asset linked to an S3 bucket, the bucket location to write to. EX: s3://bucket/prefix
parameters.help_text: This is optional, Only needed when writing to an external data asset that has a linked s3 bucket

parameters.name: List of paths to samples
parameters.description: Samples to add to the storage: .h5/.h5ad files, SpatialData .zarr folders (their table is added), folders holding them, or globs, separated by commas. EX: /data/samples, /data/other/sample1.h5ad
parameters.help_text: Paths must be inside data assets attached to this capsule. Folders are not searched recursively. Samples already in the store are skipped.

parameters.name: Celltypist Model
parameters.description: Which CellTypist models label the cells. An existing store accepts only the option it was created with.
extra_data: CellTypist Immune_All High and Low labels

parameters.name: Custom Celltypist model (.pkl, optional)
parameters.description: A CellTypist model file to use instead of the dropdown, e.g. one trained for a spatial gene panel. Several can be separated by commas. EX: /data/models/my_model.pkl
parameters.help_text: Leave empty to use the dropdown. The model's name (the file name without .pkl) names the label columns, so keep using the same file for one store.
